Bu politika, MiniOyun (\"site\") ziyaret: This policy explains what information is collected from visitors to MiniOyun ("the site") and how it is used. This English version is provided for information; the Turkish version prevails
Sitemizde üyelik yoktur ve sizden ad, e-: The site has no mandatory accounts and does not ask for personal information such as your name or email. Your high scores, favorite and recently played games, profile nickname and avatar, game statistics, badges, daily challenge results, sound preference and cookie preference are stored in your own browser (localStorage)
Liderlik tablolarında yer alabilmeniz iç: So that you can appear on leaderboards, your score, nickname and avatar are sent to our server when you finish a game and are visible to everyone on the leaderboards. No email or password is required for this; your browser is given an anonymous session ID. If you choose to link your email address on the profile page, it is used only to send you sign-in links, and your progress (records, badges, statistics) is backed up in the cloud. In online game rooms, your moves are only sent to the other player in that room and are not stored. Data is kept on Supabase servers in the European Union. You can permanently delete your account, scores and backup at any time with the "Delete my account and scores" button on the profile page. We recommend not using your real name as your nickname
Sitemizde Google AdSense reklamları göst: The site may show Google AdSense ads. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and/or other sites on the Internet
Kişiselleştirilmiş reklamcılığı <a href=: You can opt out of personalized advertising in Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of third-party vendors' personalized advertising cookies by visiting www.aboutads.info. To learn how Google uses data, see this page.
Site trafiğini anlamak için <a href=\"ht: We use GoatCounter to understand site traffic. GoatCounter does not use cookies, does not store your IP address and does not identify you personally; it only anonymously counts how often each page is opened, how many games are finished and general browser/country information.
6698 sayılı KVKK ve Avrupa Birliği Genel: You can send requests regarding your rights under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) to the address on the Contact page.
Sitemiz 13 yaşın altındaki çocuklardan b: The site does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13
